name: Shénhuà Zhànshì: Fùchóu de Qiánzòu Qǔ
summary:
One day, the elder of Firir Village asks the protagonist Leo to deliver a magic staff to the northern "Ice Archipelago" — a staff that had gone missing half a year ago when the village chief's granddaughter Tina accidentally misused a teleportation spell. After some consideration, Leo agrees.
But on the road, Leo is attacked by demon clan members claiming to serve the "evil god Yalqido," and finds himself unexpectedly drawn into the bitter fruit of racial hatred — sown 47 years ago... in a war between gods.
